Q325.reason: "All planets are smaller than Jupiter" is (∀x)(Px ⊃ Sxj), and Sxy means x is smaller than y, so the planet goes first.

Q310.reason: An octagon has n(n-3)/2 = 8·5/2 = 20 diagonals. Each vertex has 5 diagonals, not 2, and each diagonal is counted from both ends.

Q690.reason: (∀x)[Ax ⊃ (∃y)(Hy • Bxy)] says every apartment is bigger than some house.

Q603.reason: A regular octagon's interior angle is (8-2)·180/8 = 135°. Only a square has 90° angles.
